name: super-browser
description: Constrained read-only browser planning and local fixture verification for the immutable Revenue Partner image.

interface.shortDescription: Plan browser research and verify exact local fixtures under fail-closed policy.
interface.longDescription: This locked image exposes comparison and provenance planning for eight provider records. Execution is limited to exact process-allowlisted local Playwright fixtures and bounded bodyless GET/HEAD requests to public IPv4-literal raw-HTTP targets. Public Playwright, authenticated profiles, proxies, hosted providers, external computer use, writes, spending, and approval-required work are non-executable.
